item.title: Why Capital One says it really closed more than 300 Trump accounts
item.description: A new court filing says months of anti-money laundering analysis—not political pressure—led to the closure of more than 300 accounts. Trump’s family organization saw hundreds of accounts closed after a major bank found it was moving money around in a suspicious way.

item.title: Influencers are being dragged for indulging in a luxury New York nature retreat on OpenAI’s dime
item.description: Nature retreats and pro-AI messaging simply don’t mix—and some attendees of OpenAI’s first-ever brand trip are learning that the hard way. When you think ChatGPT, do you think of lush forests, relaxing retreats, and community bonding? Probably not—but with its first-ever brand trip, OpenAI seemingly aimed to change that perception.

item.title: Fender’s CEO compared cover bands to AI. Now he’s walking it back
item.description: The backlash shows how fraught the debate over artificial intelligence has become for musicians and fans alike. The CEO of the world’s biggest guitar brand has drawn the ire of musicians after comparing cover bands to chatbots, seemingly dismissing both as fundamentally uncreative. He now wants to set the record straight.

item.title: Un étage de fusée SpaceX va s’écraser sur la Lune demain matin
item.description: Un étage de fusée Falcon 9, resté en orbite depuis un lancement lunaire en janvier 2025, doit s'écraser sur la Lune ce mercredi 5 août vers 8h35, heure de Paris. L'impact, sans danger pour la Terre, doit permettre d'observer en direct la formation d'un cratère lunaire.
